verdict.line: You lose if you let Riven dash in with Valor (E) up and chain Ki Burst (W) into a full Broken Wings (Q) combo uncontested; you win if you hold Facebreaker (E) for the moment her Valor is down and cash in Haymaker's stored Grit before she resets.

brief.thesis: Lane stats read even (50% Sett baseline, 43.9% head-to-head over 424 games) because this is a mechanical duel, not a stat check: Riven's threat exists only while Valor (E, cd 10/9/8/7/6s) is up, since that's her only dash and only damage block. Sett has no way to interrupt her Q (Broken Wings) dash chain once it starts, but his Facebreaker (E, cd 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s) hard-punishes any commitment she makes without Valor in reserve. The gap between 'even' lane stats and a losing head-to-head win rate is entirely about who plays their cooldown windows better.

theirWindow.when: Valor (E) up and Ki Burst (W) off cooldown
theirWindow.what: She can engage through Broken Wings' dash strikes into a Ki Burst stun while Valor is banked to either extend the trade or block your Haymaker (W) punch and disengage. Don't commit your W's stored Grit into this window — you'll trade it into a shield she can just walk out of.

yourWindow.what: She has no dash and no damage block for the next 6-10 seconds. Walk up, land Facebreaker (E) at 490 range, and follow with Knuckle Down's (Q) two enhanced hits plus a full Haymaker (W) dump — she cannot disengage or absorb any of it.

start.why: Highest sample and win rate at this level (46.4% over 418 games, 78.3% pick) — the sustain matters directly against Riven's short-cooldown poke chain.

boots.why: Standard pick at 76.9% (42.3% over 383 games) — Riven's Runic Blade passive is entirely auto-attack damage, and flat physical reduction blunts every empowered hit she lands.

core.why: Highest-winrate opening item (60.7% path over 84 games) — the slow on proc keeps her inside Facebreaker range once you land the stun.
Shred stacks compound with your already-frequent auto-attacks between cooldowns, and the extra HP buys you time to survive her burst windows.
Bulk plus damage that scales with your max HP, syncing with Q's missing-health execute pattern and Haymaker's Grit-based shield.

situational.when: you're behind and need to survive her all-in burst rather than out-trade it
you're ahead and want your cooldowns back faster to keep the Facebreaker/Haymaker punish loop online
the game goes long and she's been shoved off you, letting you pressure a side lane instead

runes.keystoneWhy: Sustained-fight healing is what actually wins this lane — this is the higher-pick page (22.3% vs 7.4% for Press the Attack), and stacking Conqueror through extended trades keeps you ahead on HP through her short-cooldown poke.

summoners.why: Dominant pick at 80.9% (43.7% win rate) — Ignite denies her Valor sustain-block trades and closes out skirmishes she'd otherwise walk away from. Take Exhaust over Ignite if you're getting outscaled and need to survive her all-ins instead of racing damage.

playing.title: Facebreaker only stuns with flanking targets
playing.detail: E pulls and stuns enemies only when they're on opposite sides of you — in a clean 1v1 with only Riven present, it slows instead of stunning. Land it near minion waves so she's caught between you and a creep for the real stun.

playing.title: Bank Grit before you punch
playing.detail: Haymaker (W) passively stores all damage you take as Grit and dumps it entirely on cast. Absorb a Q chain or two before firing it back so the shield and true-damage center hit are worth committing.

playing.title: Read her Runic Blade charge
playing.detail: Her basic attacks expend stacked charges for bonus damage. If she's been landing abilities recently, her next auto hits harder than it looks — don't trade into a fresh-charged swing.

playing.title: Poke with Knuckle Down before all-in
playing.detail: Q's next two attacks deal bonus damage based on your target's max health, and moving toward her grants move speed. Use it to close distance and chip her down before you commit Facebreaker.

playing.title: Don't fight into level 2 Ki Burst
playing.detail: She can take W first and stun-into-Q you the instant she hits 2. Hold trades until you have Facebreaker online at level 3.

playing.title: Hunt with Show Stopper post-6
playing.detail: R has 400 range and carries her away from minions and allies before slamming — use it the moment she oversteps without Valor up, since she has no way to block or escape the grab.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, rune pages, and win-rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the cooldown numbers, ability mechanics, and tactical reasoning (Valor windows, the Facebreaker flanking rule, Grit timing) are my own read of the kit, not sourced from OP.GG.

stats.opponentTip: Check Riven’s Conqueror stacks before fighting her. Use your abilities whenever the come off cooldown to deal damage. Use your lane sustain to gain control over lane.
